_doc: PROMOTION-GATE grandfather baseline. A frozen, SHRINK-ONLY allowlist of prompts that were promoted BEFORE this gate existed and have no passing eval. Each is tolerated ONLY at the exact promotedHash recorded. This is the same discipline as scripts/ci/typecheck-baseline.txt.
